whyFalse.whyItWorks: Most of it is true; one inference is leapt to — expendable material — and that turns a true story into a false one.

Moldova has been an EU candidate since 2022, with accession negotiations initiated in 2023. Armenia, while not a candidate, collaborates closely with the EU, adopting a Strategic Agenda in 2025 to enhance cooperation. These actions demonstrate the EU's commitment to fostering development and integration, contrary to claims of exploitation.
